# Renal and Urology News

> A comprehensive medical news and education platform covering nephrology, urology, and kidney disease with clinical guidelines, CME courses, and expert insights.

Renal and Urology News provides practicing clinicians and healthcare professionals with up-to-date coverage of kidney disease, urologic cancers, and treatment advances. The site combines breaking news, in-depth features, continuing education, and clinical reference materials to support evidence-based practice in nephrology and urology.

## Key Topics

- Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
- Acute Kidney Injury (AKI)
- Diabetic Nephropathy
- Bladder Cancer
- Prostate Cancer
- SGLT2 Inhibitors
- GLP-1 Agonists
- Dialysis
- KDIGO Guidelines
- Lupus Nephritis
- Vasculitis
- Clinical Trials
- Immunotherapy
- Finerenone
- Medical Education

## Medical News & Clinical Updates

- [News Archive - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/news): Archive of medical news covering prostate, bladder, kidney disease and urology topics
- [Features Archive - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/features): In-depth feature articles on bladder cancer, kidney disease and clinical research
- [Commentary Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/commentary): Expert commentary on kidney care guidelines, prostate cancer and clinical topics
- [Special Collections - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/special-collections): Curated collections of meeting insights and clinician perspectives on renal urology

## Continuing Medical Education

- [Nephrology & Urology CME/CE Courses - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/nephrology-urology-cme): CME/CE continuing education courses for nephrology and urology professionals
- [Clinical Quiz Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/hm-article-type/clinical-quiz): Educational clinical quizzes covering lupus nephritis, kidney disease and cancer
- [Fact Sheets Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/hm-article-type/fact-sheets): Fact sheets on kidney disease, prostate health, hypertension and diabetes

## Clinical Reference & Diagnosis

- [Diagnosis & Disease Information - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/ddi): Medical reference for kidney disease diagnosis including AKI and cardiorenal syndrome

## Kidney Disease Topics

- [Chronic Kidney Disease Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/chronic-kidney-disease): CKD treatment and research news including finerenone and clinical trials
- [Acute Kidney Injury Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/acute-kidney-injury): News and research on acute kidney injury treatment and prevention strategies
- [Diabetic Nephropathy Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/diabetic-nephropathy): Diabetic nephropathy treatment news covering SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists
- [Dialysis Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/dialysis): Dialysis treatment news covering hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and outcomes
- [Anemia Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/anemia): Articles on anemia treatment in CKD including HIF-PHI therapy and darbepoetin

## Urologic & Systemic Disease Topics

- [Bladder Cancer Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/bladder-cancer): Bladder cancer treatment news including immunotherapy and clinical trials
- [Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/benign-prostatic-hyperplasia): BPH treatment news covering surgical procedures and medications
- [Diabetes Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/diabetes): Diabetes research and treatment news including GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors
- [Cardiovascular Disease Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/cardiovascular-disease): Cardiovascular disease news covering vasculitis and heart failure in renal patients

## Conferences & Events

- [Conferences - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/conferences): Directory of major nephrology, urology and oncology conferences and meetings

## Optional Resources

- [Contrast Nephropathy Archives - Renal and Urology News](https://www.renalandurologynews.com/subjects/contrast-nephropathy): News on contrast-induced AKI prevention and imaging safety in kidney disease
